question.text: Which of the following statements is not correct?

options.text: Antiseptics can be safely applied to the living tissues
Antiseptics can be incorporated into deoderants, face powders and soaps
Disinfectants can also be applied to the skin safely
A very dilute solution of a few disinfectants can be used as antiseptics

solution.text: Disinfectants are harmful to the living tissues hence they are not applied to the skin.
